rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Management of International Aviation Carbon Emissions and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Management of International Aviation Carbon Emissions and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Carbon Dioxide from International Operations Excluded from International Aviation Carbon) In the proviso to Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Act on the Management of International Aviation Carbon Emissions (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the term “international operations prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, such as medical and firefighting operations” refers to any of the international operations falling under any of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Carbon Dioxide from International Operations Excluded from International Aviation Carbon) In the proviso to Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Act on the Management of International Aviation Carbon Emissions (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the term “international operations prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, such as medical and firefighting operations” refers to any of the international operations falling under any of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. International operations for medical and firefighting purposes
rows.text_en: 1. International operations for medical and firefighting purposes

rows.source_ko: 2. International flights for relief activities
rows.text_en: 2. International flights for relief activities

rows.source_ko: 3. Other international operations deemed necessary to be excluded from the offsetting and reduction of international aviation carbon emissions as stipulated in the International Civil Aviation Convention and Annex 16 of the same Convention
rows.text_en: 3. Other international operations deemed necessary to be excluded from the offsetting and reduction of international aviation carbon emissions as stipulated in the International Civil Aviation Convention and Annex 16 of the same Convention

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Matters to be included in the basic plan, etc.) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 5, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Act refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Matters to be included in the basic plan, etc.) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 5, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Act refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Matters concerning education and promotion of international aviation carbon emission management
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning education and promotion of international aviation carbon emission management

rows.source_ko: 2. Matters concerning the training and support of experts for the management of international aviation carbon emissions
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the training and support of experts for the management of international aviation carbon emissions

rows.source_ko: 3. Matters concerning the promotion of industries for the management of international aviation carbon emissions
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the promotion of industries for the management of international aviation carbon emissions

rows.source_ko: 4. Matters concerning international cooperation for the management of international aviation carbon emissions
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning international cooperation for the management of international aviation carbon emissions

rows.source_ko: 5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport for the offsetting or reduction of international aviation carbon emissions
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport for the offsetting or reduction of international aviation carbon emissions

rows.source_ko: ② In Article 2, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Management of International Aviation Carbon Emissions (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, such as matters concerning education and promotion of international aviation carbon emission management” refers to the matters in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 (excluding Subparagraph 3).
rows.text_en: ② In Article 2, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Management of International Aviation Carbon Emissions (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, such as matters concerning education and promotion of international aviation carbon emission management” refers to the matters in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 (excluding Subparagraph 3).

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Designation and Notification of Obligation Person) ①An aircraft operator who intends to be designated as an obligation person (hereinafter referred to as “obligation person”) required to offset or reduce international aviation carbon emissions pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for designation of obligation person in the form of Annex 1 , attaching data that can verify international aviation carbon emissions for the last four years, including the year of application for designation.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Designation and Notification of Obligation Person) ①An aircraft operator who intends to be designated as an obligation person (hereinafter referred to as “obligation person”) required to offset or reduce international aviation carbon emissions pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for designation of obligation person in the form of Annex 1 , attaching data that can verify international aviation carbon emissions for the last four years, including the year of application for designation.

rows.source_ko: ② International aviation carbon emissions pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be calculated according to the formula in Item 1 of Annex 3 of the Enforcement Decree or the emission estimation and reporting method in Item 2 of the same table.
rows.text_en: ② International aviation carbon emissions pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be calculated according to the formula in Item 1 of Annex 3 of the Enforcement Decree or the emission estimation and reporting method in Item 2 of the same table.

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may request aircraft operators to submit relevant data, such as international flight performance records, if necessary to designate a party obligated to perform under Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act .
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may request aircraft operators to submit relevant data, such as international flight performance records, if necessary to designate a party obligated to perform under Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ④ When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport requests data pursuant to Paragraph 3, he/she must make a request to the relevant aircraft operator in writing, specifying the scope and content of the data and the reasons for the request.
rows.text_en: ④ When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport requests data pursuant to Paragraph 3, he/she must make a request to the relevant aircraft operator in writing, specifying the scope and content of the data and the reasons for the request.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport designates and notifies a person obligated to perform pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall notify the relevant person obligated to perform of such fact.
rows.text_en: ⑤ When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport designates and notifies a person obligated to perform pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall notify the relevant person obligated to perform of such fact.

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Application for Approval or Modification of Monitoring Plan) ① In accordance with the first part of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act , if a party obligated to perform intends to obtain approval for a monitoring plan (hereinafter referred to as the “monitoring plan”) pursuant to the same paragraph, they must submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for approval of an international aviation carbon emission monitoring plan in the form of Annex 2 , with the monitoring plan attached.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Application for Approval or Modification of Monitoring Plan) ① In accordance with the first part of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act , if a party obligated to perform intends to obtain approval for a monitoring plan (hereinafter referred to as the “monitoring plan”) pursuant to the same paragraph, they must submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for approval of an international aviation carbon emission monitoring plan in the form of Annex 2 , with the monitoring plan attached.

rows.source_ko: ② If the obligor intends to obtain approval for a change to the monitoring plan pursuant to the latter part of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act , they must submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for approval of a change to the international aviation carbon emissions monitoring plan in the form of Annex 2, attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: ② If the obligor intends to obtain approval for a change to the monitoring plan pursuant to the latter part of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act , they must submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for approval of a change to the international aviation carbon emissions monitoring plan in the form of Annex 2, attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Monitoring plan reflecting changes
rows.text_en: 1. Monitoring plan reflecting changes

rows.source_ko: 2. Comparison Table with Previous Monitoring Plan
rows.text_en: 2. Comparison Table with Previous Monitoring Plan

rows.source_ko: ③ If the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport recognizes that the monitoring plan submitted pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 has been prepared in accordance with the Guidelines on the Management of International Aviation Carbon Emissions prescribed and notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport pursuant to the first part of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act, the Minister shall approve the said monitoring plan or the change to the monitoring plan.
rows.text_en: ③ If the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport recognizes that the monitoring plan submitted pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 has been prepared in accordance with the Guidelines on the Management of International Aviation Carbon Emissions prescribed and notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport pursuant to the first part of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act, the Minister shall approve the said monitoring plan or the change to the monitoring plan.

rows.source_ko: ④ When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport approves a monitoring plan or a change to the monitoring plan pursuant to Paragraph 3, he/she shall notify the relevant obligor of such fact.
rows.text_en: ④ When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport approves a monitoring plan or a change to the monitoring plan pursuant to Paragraph 3, he/she shall notify the relevant obligor of such fact.

rows.source_ko: Article 6 (Cancellation of Designation of Obligation to Perform) ① If an obligation to performintends to request the cancellation of designation pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 4 of the Act , the obligation to perform shall submit an application for cancellation of designation of obligation to perform in the form of Annex 3 to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Cancellation of Designation of Obligation to Perform) ① If an obligor intends to request the cancellation of its designation pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 4 of the Act, the obligor shall submit an application for cancellation of designation in the form of Annex 3 to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.

rows.source_ko: ② When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport intends to revoke the designation of a party obligated to perform pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 6, Paragraph 4 of the Act (excluding the case of Subparagraph 1 of the same Paragraph), he/she shall verify whether the relevant party obligated to perform has fulfilled the offset obligation pursuant to the main text of Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act .
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport intends to revoke the designation of a party obligated to perform pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 6, Paragraph 4 of the Act (excluding the case of Subparagraph 1 of the same Paragraph), he/she shall verify whether the relevant party obligated to perform has fulfilled the offset obligation pursuant to the main text of Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ In cases where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport cancels the designation of a party obligated to perform pursuant to the main text of Article 6, Paragraph 4 of the Act , he/she shall notify the relevant aircraft operator of such fact.
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport cancels the designation of a party obligated to perform pursuant to the main text of Article 6, Paragraph 4 of the Act , he/she shall notify the relevant aircraft operator of such fact.

rows.source_ko: Article 7 (Deadline for Submission of Emission Reports and Emission Verification Reports) In the first part of Article 8, Paragraph 4 of the Act , the term “deadline prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to April 30 of each year.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Deadline for Submission of Emission Reports and Emission Verification Reports) In the first part of Article 8, Paragraph 4 of the Act , the term “deadline prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to April 30 of each year.

rows.source_ko: Article 8 (Calculation and Notification of Mandatory Offset Amounts, etc.) ① When the Korea Transportation Safety Authority calculates the mandatory offset amount pursuant to Article 9 , Paragraph 1 and the first part of Paragraph 2 of the Act , it shall consider the following matters:
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Calculation and Notification of Mandatory Offset Amounts, etc.) ① When the Korea Transportation Safety Authority calculates the mandatory offset amount pursuant to Article 9 , Paragraph 1 and the first part of Paragraph 2 of the Act , it shall consider the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. The previous year's international aviation carbon emissions of the obligor pursuant to the emissions report under Article 8 , Paragraph 2 of the Act and the verification report on the conformity of the emissions report under Article 8, Paragraph 3 of the same Act
rows.text_en: 1. The previous year's international aviation carbon emissions of the obligor pursuant to the emissions report under Article 8 , Paragraph 2 of the Act and the verification report on the conformity of the emissions report under Article 8, Paragraph 3 of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 2. The Obligor's usage of sustainable aviation fuel in the previous year (referring to aviation fuel that meets the sustainability criteria set forth in the International Civil Aviation Convention and Annex 16 of the same Convention; hereinafter the same applies).
rows.text_en: 2. The Obligor's usage of sustainable aviation fuel in the previous year (referring to aviation fuel that meets the sustainability criteria set forth in the International Civil Aviation Convention and Annex 16 of the same Convention; hereinafter the same applies).

rows.source_ko: 3. Matters that the International Civil Aviation Organization announces need to be considered in the calculation of offset obligations
rows.text_en: 3. Matters that the International Civil Aviation Organization announces need to be considered in the calculation of offset obligations

rows.source_ko: 4. Other matters that the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport deems necessary to consider in calculating the mandatory offset amount.
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters that the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport deems necessary to consider in calculating the mandatory offset amount.

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall notify each obligor of the amount of offset obligation calculated pursuant to Paragraph 1 of this Article by November 30 of each year, in accordance with Article 9, Paragraph 1 and the latter part of Paragraph 2 of the Act.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall notify each obligor of the amount of offset obligation calculated pursuant to Paragraph 1 of this Article by November 30 of each year, in accordance with Article 9, Paragraph 1 and the latter part of Paragraph 2 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, detailed matters necessary for the calculation and notification of the offset obligation amount shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport .
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, detailed matters necessary for the calculation and notification of the offset obligation amount shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport .

rows.source_ko: Article 9 (Deadline for Performance, Reporting, etc. of Offset Obligation Amount) ① The term “deadline prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in the main text of Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to January 31 of the year following the year after the last year of each performance period (referring to a three-year period starting from 2021) (hereinafter referred to as the “year of completion of performance” in this Article).
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Deadline for Performance, Reporting, etc. of Offset Obligation Amount) ① The term “deadline prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in the main text of Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to January 31 of the year following the year after the last year of each performance period (referring to a three-year period starting from 2021) (hereinafter referred to as the “year of completion of performance” in this Article).

rows.source_ko: ② In the first part of Article 10, Paragraph 4 of the Act , the term “deadline prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to April 30 of the year of completion of implementation.
rows.text_en: ② In the first part of Article 10, Paragraph 4 of the Act , the term “deadline prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to April 30 of the year of completion of implementation.

rows.source_ko: Article 10 (Storage and Management of Materials) ① The materials that the obligor must keep pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Storage and Management of Materials) ① The materials that the obligor must keep pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. Monitoring Plan
rows.text_en: 1. Monitoring Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. The emission report pursuant to Article 8 , Paragraph 2 of the Act and the verification report on the conformity of the emission report pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Article
rows.text_en: 2. The emission report pursuant to Article 8 , Paragraph 2 of the Act and the verification report on the conformity of the emission report pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Article

rows.source_ko: 3. Report on the fulfillment of offset obligations pursuant to Article 10 , Paragraph 2 of the Act and a verification report on the conformity of the report on the fulfillment of offset obligations pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Article
rows.text_en: 3. Report on the fulfillment of offset obligations pursuant to Article 10 , Paragraph 2 of the Act and a verification report on the conformity of the report on the fulfillment of offset obligations pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Article

rows.source_ko: 4. Data on the usage history of sustainable aviation fuel
rows.text_en: 4. Data on the usage history of sustainable aviation fuel

rows.source_ko: 5. Other data that the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport deems necessary to retain in relation to the offsetting and reduction of international aviation carbon emissions.
rows.text_en: 5. Other data that the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport deems necessary to retain in relation to the offsetting and reduction of international aviation carbon emissions.

rows.source_ko: ② The materials pursuant to Paragraph 1 must be managed to prevent damage or defacement, and their contents must not be arbitrarily modified or added without justification.
rows.text_en: ② The materials pursuant to Paragraph 1 must be managed to prevent damage or defacement, and their contents must not be arbitrarily modified or added without justification.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 1382, Aug. 21, 2024>

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on August 21, 2024.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on August 21, 2024.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Applicability to Storage of Data)  The provisions of each subparagraph of Article 10, Paragraph 1 shall also apply to data generated after 2021, provided that the monitoring plan was approved by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport prior to the enforcement of this rule.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Storage of Data)  The provisions of each subparagraph of Article 10, Paragraph 1 shall also apply to data generated after 2021, provided that the monitoring plan was approved by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport prior to the enforcement of this rule.
